jobs.title: Manager Health Information Management Coding - Coding
jobs.description:
**Description**  

Summary:


The Manager Health Information Management Coding oversees daily coding operations to support remote coding associates in meeting and exceeding performance metrics. The Manager HIM Coding reports to the Director of HIM Coding Operations and works collaboratively with customer groups across all levels of the systems organization and facilities. The Manager ensures that Associates follow CHRISTUS standards, policies, and practices along with industry\-specific coding guidelines and federal guidelines directing correct coding initiatives. These include American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) and American Hospital Association (AHA) practices and coding rules, among other regulatory agencies such as CMS, the Joint Commission, and related to HIM Coding operations. This role ensures that coding operations are standardized, meet regulatory requirements, and support hospital operations and revenue cycle initiatives. The Manager HIM Coding is expected to maintain effective professional relationships to coach, encourage, instruct, share, and implement actions in support of remote Coding Associates and related to coding functions and process improvements. This role monitors and reports barriers to meeting our key performance indicators as requested by the System Director of HIM.


Responsibilities:

  

* Meets expectations of the applicable OneCHRISTUS Competencies: Leader of Self, Leader of Others, or Leader of Leaders.
* Analyze internal and external audit results to identify individual and global improvement opportunities.
* Participate in audit discussions and ensure timely updates to billing systems following audit\-related rebills.
* Provide coaching and feedback to coding staff based on audit findings and support the Lead in managing audit rebuttals.
* Ensure coding staff attend all required and supplemental training, including inpatient/outpatient coding, APC, MS\-DRG/APR\-DRG, and Coding Integrity education.
* Deliver education to external coding consultants and contracted entities in alignment with CHRISTUS HIM standards.
* Coordinate and provide training for non\-coding staff, including physicians, billing personnel, and ancillary departments, on documentation, coding compliance, and data management.
* Support the Education Manager in serving as a resource for regional staff, department directors, and administration on coding and documentation standards.
* Facilitate cross\-training opportunities for coding staff to enhance team flexibility and coverage.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and liaison for coding\-related issues across the organization.
* Oversee coder work assignments, manage account reallocation, and monitor coding/billing reports to ensure timely processing.
* Collaborate with corporate and regional departments (e.g., CDI, HIM, Revenue Cycle, IT) to optimize workflows and reduce billing errors.
* Partner with Coding Integrity, Compliance, and Quality teams to analyze coding trends and support educational initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to ethical coding standards (AHIMA/AAPC) and CHRISTUS\-wide policies and procedures.
* Monitor regulatory changes affecting documentation, reimbursement, and coding to maintain compliance.
* Support denial management processes related to HIM and coding issues.
* Contribute to discussions and implementations of new systems and processes to improve coding and billing accuracy.
* Lead and support team performance through coaching, documentation, scheduling, and conflict resolution.
* Promote a culture of teamwork, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Participate in interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and training new coding associates.
* Produce clinical and statistical reports for use in hospital efficiency, quality assurance, administrative planning, compliance reporting, and medical research.
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned by leadership.


Job Requirements:

  

**Education/Skills**  

* Bachelor's degree, medical record science/administration, or equivalent healthcare leadership experience required.
* Extensive knowledge of health information management functions, including coding and compliance (ICD\-10/PCS, CPT coding systems, MS\-DRGs, and APCs) required.
* Knowledge of internal integrity requirements and procedures.
* Knowledge of governmental, federal, state, and local regulations related to billing rules and compliance.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and other web\-based applications).

**Experience**  

* 3\+ years of coding supervisory/management experience preferred.
* At least 5 years of experience in a medical record department of a mid\-to\-large inpatient facility preferred.
* Remote work force operations experience required.
* Centralized staffing model experience preferred.

**Licenses, Registrations, or Certifications**  

* Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) preferred.
  


Work Schedule:

  

8AM \- 5PM Monday\-Friday


Work Type:

  

Full Time

jobs.title: Intraoral Scanner Technical Support & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Anaheim, CA  
Job Type: Full\-Time  
Pay: $25\.00–$30\.00 per hour, depending on experience

**Position Overview**

DOF USA is seeking an Intraoral Scanner Technical Support \& Training Specialist to support our FREEDOM Air intraoral scanner and our growing customer base throughout the United States.

FREEDOM Air is DOF’s innovative 2\-in\-1 solution combining intraoral scanning and photogrammetry in a single device.

This position will be responsible for providing technical support, customer training, product demonstrations, and onboarding for FREEDOM Air. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working with both customers and technology and is interested in growing within the digital dentistry field.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for FREEDOM Air
* Assist customers with scanner software, connectivity, scanning, and general technical issues
* Provide remote and in\-person product training
* Train dentists, dental assistants, dental laboratories, and dealers
* Conduct product demonstrations and customer onboarding
* Support intraoral scanning and photogrammetry workflows
* Assist with implant and full\-arch scanning workflows
* Attend dental trade shows, seminars, and industry events as a DOF representative
* Work closely with DOF USA sales and technical support teams
* Communicate technical issues and customer feedback to DOF headquarters
* Follow up on open technical support cases and maintain support records

**Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable working with computers, software, and new technology
* Ability to learn new technical workflows and explain them clearly to customers
* Willingness to travel for customer training and dental industry events
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Valid driver's license

**Preferred Qualifications**

Dental industry experience is preferred, especially experience with:

* Intraoral scanners
* Dental assisting
* Digital dentistry
* Dental CAD/CAM
* Dental laboratory workflows
* Implant dentistry
* Full\-arch workflows
* Technical support or customer training

Previous dental experience is preferred but not required. DOF USA will provide initial training on FREEDOM Air, scanner software, troubleshooting, photogrammetry, and related digital workflows.

Korean language skills are a plus but not required.

**About DOF**

DOF is a global digital dentistry company specializing in advanced scanning and CAD/CAM solutions.

DOF USA provides sales, training, and technical support throughout the United States for FREEDOM Air, our 2\-in\-1 intraoral scanner and photogrammetry solution, as well as our desktop scanners and dental milling systems.

If you enjoy working with technology and customers and are interested in building a career in digital dentistry, we encourage you to apply.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* On\-the\-job training
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Enterprise Accounts
jobs.description:
Healthcare documentation is broken. Nestmed is fixing it with an AI platform that gives clinicians their time back.


In just one year, we’ve scaled to support tens of thousands of clinicians across more than a million patient visits. We're now the trusted partner for over 60 home health agencies, including 7 of the top 10 enterprises in the US.


Our founding team—hailing from Stanford, YC, Google, and Meta—is backed by the founders of PayPal and Plaid to build the essential infrastructure for the future of the $500B home healthcare industry.


Nestmed's fastest\-growing customers are enterprise multi\-state home health and hospice organizations with hundreds of branches, thousands of clinicians, and tight implementation timelines. We're looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to own these enterprise rollouts end to end: designing the rollout strategy, sequencing branch\-by\-branch go\-lives, and turning time\-strapped clinicians across a sprawling org into confident daily users, at scale.


This isn't just a training role that happens to touch big accounts. It's ownership of the implementation itself: the plan, the phasing, the executive relationship, and the outcome. We’re looking for someone who has done this before and knows how to avoid risks, manage exec level stakeholders, leverage their project management skills, hold strong technical skills and can quickly learn the US home health and hospice landscape.

**What You'll Do**

**Enterprise Rollout Strategy**

* Own the end\-to\-end implementation plan for large, multi\-branch home health and hospice accounts, from kickoff through full adoption across every branch
* Design phased go\-live sequencing (by region, branch tier, or clinical service line) that fits the customer's operational reality, not a generic template
* Build and manage the master implementation timeline, coordinating dependencies across IT, clinical leadership, and branch\-level operations
* Anticipate potential failure points specific to large orgs: competing regional priorities, inconsistent branch\-level readiness, leadership turnover mid\-rollout and build contingency plans before they become escalations

**Training \& Enablement at Scale**

* Lead virtual and on\-site training for clinicians and office staff across dozens to hundreds of branches
* Design and run train\-the\-trainer programs that let branch\-level champions cascade training locally
* Provide targeted 1:1 and small\-group coaching for slower adopter branches
* Travel up to 20% to customer sites for executive check\-ins, regional kickoffs, and high\-stakes go\-lives

**Executive \& Cross\-Functional Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary implementation point of contact for customer executive sponsors (VP/Director of Clinical Operations, Regional Directors) throughout the engagement
* Partner closely with Implementation Leadership on account strategy, executive business reviews, and renewal risk tied to adoption
* Track and report implementation health with rigor
* Proactively identify and escalate at\-risk implementations before they threaten a renewal or expansion

**Adoption \& Change Management**

* Build trust with clinicians and branch leadership by deeply understanding their workflow and how it varies branch to branch within the same organization
* Identify systemic adoption barriers (not just individual stragglers) and design interventions that work across a distributed org
* Monitor usage data across the account and drive targeted follow\-up with low\-engagement branches or regions
* Deliver post\-go\-live reinforcement training and manage the long tail of adoption in a large account, which rarely ends at go\-live

**Clinician \& Customer Advocacy**

* Share frontline and branch\-level insights with Product, Engineering, and CS to influence roadmap and account strategy
* Surface patterns across enterprise accounts, friction that shows up at scale often looks different from friction at a single small agency
* Contribute to case studies and reference\-ability efforts for flagship enterprise accounts

**Who You Are**

**Required**

* 7\+ years in implementation, training, or customer success roles, with direct experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder rollouts. Enterprise healthcare experience strongly preferred
* Proven track record leading implementations for large, multi\-location organizations (not single\-site deployments)
* Strong program/project management instincts, being comfortable owning a timeline with dozens of moving parts and no one else tracking it for you
* Executive presence: credible and persuasive with Senior Leadership, not just end users
* Exceptional presentation, facilitation, and written communication skills
* Comfortable learning new technology quickly and translating it for non\-technical, clinical audiences
* Empathetic, patient, and energized by helping others learn while also being able to hold a large org accountable to a timeline
* Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced startup and is comfortable operating with ambiguity in a scaling implementation function
* Willing to travel 20% (U.S.)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience implementing or training clinicians on EMR/EHR or clinical software at scale
* Home health or hospice experience, especially with multi\-branch or multi\-state agencies
* Background in change management, instructional design, or adult learning
* Experience with LMS or training platforms, and with implementation/project tracking tools
* Familiarity with home health and hospice\-specific workflows and regulatory context (OASIS, PDGM, visit compliance)


If you’re passionate about working with high\-impact products that solve real\-world problems, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!


Compensation Range: $115K \- $125K
